name: Stocks
author: lipi
description: A stock portfolio widget for the bar: live quotes for the tickers you own, a range chart, and today's and unrealized gains, with an inline search to add holdings.

barWidget.description: Live prices and performance for your portfolio. Click the bar to open the panel, search a ticker, then set shares and average cost to track gains. Tickers with zero shares are watch-only.

schema.label: Bar readout
schema.description: What the bar shows: today's portfolio move in percent, the move in money, the total market value, or just the icon.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often live quotes are re-fetched from Yahoo Finance.

schema.label: Show icon
schema.description: Show the chart glyph before the bar readout.

schema.label: Show sparklines
schema.description: Draw a small intraday chart for every holding in the panel.
